name: What are the signs of a gas leak?

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of a gas leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signs of a gas leak include a distinct sulfur-like odor (like rotten eggs), a hissing sound near gas appliances or pipes, dead or discolored vegetation over an underground gas line, or an unexplained increase in your gas bill. If you suspect a gas leak, immediately evacuate the premises, do not use electrical switches or phones, and call your gas provider and a licensed plumber from a safe location. CG Plumbing Solutions can respond to such emergencies.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs of a gas leak include a rotten egg smell, hissing sounds, dead plants, or a high gas bill. Evacuate and call for help immediately if suspected.
